form_inputs.box_type: Prompt Delivery Contract / Freeze-Intake Metadata / Handoff Guardrail
form_inputs.do_not_regress_rules:
Governed patch ZIPs must include root-level KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json unless intentionally non-freezeable.
KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json must name the actual feature implemented by the patch, not an older feature inferred heuristically.
The sidecar is delivery metadata only and must not be treated as frozen memory or source of truth.
The sidecar must not be installed into the project root unless a separate governed app contract explicitly requires it.
Freeze form correction must use actual validation evidence supplied by the user and must not invent validation.
Patch answers must separate installed payload files from delivery metadata files.
Handoffs after governed patch work must include freeze-intake metadata for the latest implemented feature.
Project-specific frozen memory must remain under project_freeze_after_update/frozen_features_memory.
Do not store project-specific frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.
Preview remains read-only and Confirm and Write remains human-confirmed.
Preview Freeze Entry must remain read-only and must not write files.
Confirm and Write must require explicit human confirmation before writing governed freeze memory.
After a local freeze write, the AI startup freeze context must be refreshed.
External AI review remains advanced/fallback, not the normal local freeze path.
form_inputs.feature_title: Freeze Hint Sidecar Delivery Contract v1
form_inputs.known_warnings: This sidecar helps the app and future chats pre-fill the correct feature identity, but it does not write freeze memory and does not bypass human confirmation.
form_inputs.notes: This patch addresses the chat-to-app information gap that caused the New Local Freeze Entry heuristic to reuse old feature names and validation lists. Future patch ZIPs should carry feature-specific freeze-intake metadata inside KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json.
form_inputs.planned_next_step: Install and validate this prompt-delivery contract update. After validation passes, freeze this feature before freezing RG-029 and RG-030.
form_inputs.primary_box: kanda_prompt_workspace/prompt_library/ACTIVE_PROMPTS/01_session_start_and_navigation + startup patch delivery guardrails + handoff guardrail
form_inputs.validation_evidence_summary: Sandbox validation passed before delivery for freeze_hint_sidecar_delivery_contract_v1_patch. Local user validation must still be run after install before freezing this feature.
